catalog.name: price_level
catalog.title: Price level
catalog.description: Did unit prices rise? Price-level effect L (window-B prices on the window-A usage shape) as a share of the bill change, plus average price per time band A vs B.

catalog.name: price_driver_generation
catalog.title: Price driver: generation mix
catalog.description: Does the generation mix explain the price move? Mean wind, gas and import share A vs B and the per-slot correlation of price with wind share in window B.

catalog.name: weather_volume
catalog.title: Weather-driven volume
catalog.description: How much of the change is cold weather? Pooled regression of daily kWh on heating degree days (base 15.5 C) with a window dummy and weekday dummies; weather volume cost = beta x change in HDD x baseline price.

catalog.name: operational_change
catalog.title: Operational change
catalog.description: Is the non-weather volume change explained by a logged event (ops_log)? V_operational = V - V_weather, then a Welch before/after step test of weather-adjusted daily kWh around each event of the scope's sites.

catalog.name: timing_shift
catalog.title: Timing shift
catalog.description: Did usage move to dearer or cheaper times of day? Timing effect T (new usage shape at new prices) as a share of the change, plus kWh share per time band A vs B.

catalog.name: one_off_day
catalog.title: One-off day
catalog.description: Is the change concentrated in one day? Share of the total change contributed by the single largest day (B day vs the aligned A day), with that day's kWh, price and heating degree days compared with the window means.

catalog.name: meter_fault
catalog.title: Meter fault
catalog.description: Is the change a metering artefact? Looks for runs of zero readings (>= 4 slots), flatlines (>= 12 identical non-zero), duplicate timestamps and days without 48 half-hours.

catalog.name: tariff_change
catalog.title: Tariff change
catalog.description: Did the tariff change? Compares product code, tariff code and standing charge of the contract in force in each window (and checks the published Agile standing charge).

catalog.name: data_gap
catalog.title: Data gap
catalog.description: Is data missing? Counts joined meter x price half-hours per site and window against the expected 1344 (28 days x 48), and meter x carbon coverage.

catalog.name: carbon
catalog.title: Carbon emissions
catalog.description: Why were emissions higher? The same exact decomposition applied to grid carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh): volume, intensity level and timing effects in kgCO2e, window B vs A.

catalog.name: usage_anomaly_day

catalog.description: Is any single site-day far from what its weather and weekday predict? Standardised residuals of daily kWh (same adjusted model as the operational-change test); flags |z| >= 4 and cites any ops_log event of that site on that date.

evidence.title: Meter quality checks (ALL)
evidence.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh FROM kilowhy.meter_hh WHERE site_id IN ('S1', 'S2', 'S3') AND ts >= timestamp '2026-08-27 00:00:00' AND ts < timestamp '2026-10-22 00:00:00'),
lagged AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh, LAG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY ts) AS prev_kwh FROM base),
grp AS (SELECT site_id, ts, kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN prev_kwh IS NULL OR kwh <> prev_kwh THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY ts) AS g FROM lagged),
runs AS (SELECT site_id, kwh, g, MIN(ts) AS start_ts, MAX(ts) AS end_ts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM grp GROUP BY site_id, kwh, g)
SELECT CASE WHEN kwh = 0 THEN 'zero_run' ELSE 'flatline' END AS check_name, site_id, CAST(start_ts AS STRING) AS start_ts, CAST(end_ts AS STRING) AS end_ts, n, kwh AS value FROM runs WHERE (kwh = 0 AND n >= 4) OR (kwh <> 0 AND n >= 12)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_ts', site_id, CAST(ts AS STRING), CAST(ts AS STRING), COUNT(*), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) FROM base GROUP BY site_id, ts HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'slots_per_day', site_id, CAST(CAST(ts AS DATE) AS STRING), CAST(CAST(ts AS DATE) AS STRING), COUNT(*), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) FROM base GROUP BY site_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) HAVING COUNT(*) <> 48
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rows', site_id, CAST(MIN(ts) AS STRING), CAST(MAX(ts) AS STRING), COUNT(*), SUM(kwh) FROM base GROUP BY site_id
ORDER BY check_name, site_id, start_ts

GROUP BY m.site_id, CASE WHEN m.ts >= timestamp '2026-08-27 00:00:00' AND m.ts < timestamp '2026-09-24 00:00:00' THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END ORDER BY m.site_id, win
